completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean every possible biblical connection has been exhausted, or independent scholarly approval.

reading_notes: All 177 actual native Sirach 34-39 units were read in order before target curation. The source-reading gate and full actual ordered source texts are preserved in the reading log. Earlier-run review was used only as a schema example and received no current reading credit.

Each cohort source is supported or precisely deferred. The 167 distinct source/target-passage pairs cover 157 sources; each passage range counts once, including the ten additional targets addressing particular facets or distinct narrative counterparts. Twenty targetless deferrals and three read but unretained candidates earn zero completed source or pair credit.

Every actual retained target and necessary context was read, followed by complete rereading of all 167 final source/target/relationship/rationale triples. Twenty-one source references received precision amendments; all twenty-two affected complete triples were then reread. All final deferred and candidate cases were also reread.

Native wording and numbering govern: Aaron's blessing ends at Numbers 6:26 here; the peace-prophet statement is Jeremiah 35:9; Proverbs 28:26 specifies a rash heart; Isaiah 28:26 does not explicitly identify the farmer as the recipient of divine instruction. No familiar wording was substituted for failed or differently numbered lookups.

Contrasts retain different speakers, claims and settings, including beauty, inward counsel, the socially rejected speaker, artisans and learned people. Corpse impurity, medical practice, mourning, creative purpose and punitive forces were not flattened into generic similarities. Uncertain interpretations remain pending.

The existing complete Sirach inventory and earlier completed objects, pending decisions and records were not modified. This is review of the supplied English edition, not original-language, specialist, critical-apparatus or live-anchor verification. Independent peer acceptance is recorded separately.

review_receipts.review_scope: Initial English-only semantic review of the supplied native edition, with complete actual source/target/context reading and exact final explanation reread. No original-language, critical-apparatus or specialist certification is claimed.

reading_notes: All 145 actual native Sirach 46-51 sources were read in order after the earlier cohort gates. All 188 retained source/target/relationship/rationale triples and all pending cases were reread. A range counts as one pair.

Seven source-only deferrals and one read but unretained candidate earn zero credit. Simon son of Onias was not equated with similarly named people; his particular construction works remain pending. The list in 50:25-26 was not matched through names alone.

Native wording and anchors were preserved: 1 Kings 20 for the Naboth judgment, Malachi 3:22-23 for Elijah, Numbers 6:23-26 for the priestly blessing, and omitted/grouped units within familiar ranges. No outside wording replaced a failed lookup.

Historical recollections, ritual parallels, literary refrains and shared images are distinguished. Sirach 49:9 retains only storm-judgment imagery, not an identified allusion. Sirach 51:10 retains prayer and praise parallels without interpreting its Father of my Lord address.

Precision amendments preserve different weapons, speakers, gestures, transliterated names and limits of target evidence. This is an initial curated pass, not exhaustive discovery or original-language, specialist or critical-apparatus verification.

peer_review_receipts.review_scope: Independent initial English-only semantic review of every actual native source, complete retained target, relationship and rationale, all zero-credit cases and all author-listed contexts. No additional completion credit, original-language or specialist certification is claimed.

Independent initial English-only semantic review of the actual native source, every retained target, relationship and rationale, all deferred and unretained cases, and all author-listed context. The final wording revisions were reread as complete triples. No additional completion credit, original-language or specialist certification is claimed.

Independent initial English-only semantic review. All 145 actual native sources, 188 retained full triples, seven source-only deferrals, one read but unretained candidate, all 1088 author-listed context units and 26 additional context units were read. Nine peer wording findings and two author precision amendments were resolved and reread. Technical preparation, inventory, reading and deferral evidence add no completion credit; no original-language or specialist certification is claimed.
